celandine_01.note: Sinks by design: ground cover whose stem bases are modelled 7 mm below the soil so no seam shows on uneven ground. Not an asset defect; kept as a finding until P5 rules how planted items are judged (Q-S36-P1-2).

grass_medium_01.note: Sinks by design: grass blades rooted 26 mm below the soil so a clump never floats on uneven ground. Kept as a finding until P5 rules how planted items are judged (Q-S36-P1-2).

hanging_industrial_lamp.note: Pass-through by design: the bulb holder (metal) runs through the glass cover's top disc, which the mesh models without a hole. Nothing shows wrong; a rigid move cannot separate them (tried), and an exact boolean on the open shells only reached 7.5 mm. Owed a mesh cut (glass minus holder); see the operator question in the S36 props PR.

potted_plant_02.note: Pass-through by design: the stems run down through the soil slab, and the soil is packed under the pot's inward-curving lip. Shrinking the soil 6 % still left 7.8 mm and would open a visible gap; no rigid move separates them. Owed a mesh cut (soil minus pot, stems minus soil); see the operator question in the S36 props PR.

shrub_02.note: Sinks by design: the stems are rooted 25 mm below the soil. The slice plants it in a planter by its bounding box (SliceProps.put), so nothing floats or sinks there. Kept as a finding until P5 rules how planted items are judged (Q-S36-P1-2).

street_lamp_02.note: A wall lantern: a back plate in the z = 0 plane from y = -395 mm to 0, a scroll bracket, and the lantern 0.6 m out from the wall. It was declared floor; its 395 mm 'sink' is the back plate. lakeside's town.gd stands it on the pavement (Props.place at y = 0), which is a placement defect for P5, not an asset one.

water_manhole_cover.note: Inset by design: the frame's collar runs 28.8 mm below the origin and its flange top is 38.8 mm above it; a real cover is set flush into the road, so neither its bottom nor its origin is meant to rest on the surface. Kept as a finding until P5 rules how inset items are judged (Q-S36-P1-2).
